business_outcome: Provide a clear read-only portfolio command UI over the existing CAP-39 Executive dashboard so the owner can manage many projects, KPIs, risks and commitments without creating a second source of truth.
existing_owner_scan: CAP-39 Executive dashboard already owns executive aggregation; the Master Project Registry owns project state; Outcome & KPI Scorecard owns metrics; Global Risk & Incident Register owns risk; Master Work Calendar owns commitments; project control centers own project-local detail.
reuse_candidates_checked: Project Control Center — Resume Here Standard
duplication_analysis: Do not create a new canonical database, control center, project registry, KPI store or authority system. The UI is presentation only and may later read canonical data through approved read-only adapters.
residual_unowned_loop: Implement a bounded static read-only portfolio command interface with preview data, search/filter/drill-down behavior, explicit source-of-truth labels and no write/deploy/payment/outbound authority.
evidence_ref: Notion A0-CAP39-UI-001 — Portfolio Dashboard UI Extension
